mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inv_stock_balance(merchant_id,store_id,sku_id,on_hand,reserved,version) VALUES(#{merchantId},#{storeId},#{skuId},0,0,0) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sku_id=sku_id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inv_stock_balance WHERE store_id=#{storeId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM inv_stock_balance WHERE sku_id IN #{id} ORDER BY sku_id

SELECT * FROM inv_stock_balance b WHERE b.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cat_sku s JOIN cat_product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE s.id=b.sku_id AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(s.id))>0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(s.spec_key))>0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(p.title))>0)) ORDER BY sku_id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE inv_stock_balance SET on_hand=#{p.onHand},reserved=#{p.reserved},version=version+1 WHERE store_id=#{p.storeId} AND sku_id=#{p.skuId} AND version=#{p.version} AND #{p.onHand} >= #{p.reserved} AND #{p.reserved} >= 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inv_reservation WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM inv_reservation WHERE order_id=#{orderId} ORDER BY sku_id FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE inv_reservation SET status=#{status} WHERE order_id=#{orderId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND status='RESERVED'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inv_stock_movement WHERE store_id=#{storeId} AND sku_id=#{skuId} AND type=#{type} AND biz_key=#{bizKey}
SELECT * FROM inv_stock_movement WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_stock_balance b WHERE b.merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cat_sku s JOIN cat_product p ON p.id=s.product_id WHERE s.id=b.sku_id AND (LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(s.id))>0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(s.spec_key))>0 OR LOCATE(LOWER(#{q}),LOWER(p.title))>0))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inv_stock_movement WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId}
